craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of sealing — utsāha as measure, course, denial, seal land in turn. SEAL: fourfold apparatus in one line (told/proved/unrefuted/useful) + full-apparatus-besides close — treatise-close performed. Rejected: (a) trimming fourfold → killed: apparatus is content. (b) besides→also → killed: besides keeps the beyond. Read aloud: TOLD, SELF-a-WARE-ness-PROVED, un-re-FUT-ed, OF-use — … FULL-ap-pa-RA-tus be-SIDES.

lines: relation in recognition — full apparatus besides.
l4.sanskrit_cite: uktaḥ svasaṃvitsiddho'yaṃ nirbādha upayogavān saṃbandhaḥ pratyabhijñāyāṃ pūrṇaḥ parikaraḥ punaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What apparatus closes? → Seal: told, proved, unrefuted, useful — relation in recognition, full apparatus besides.
c1_essence: Secondaries measured against chiefs — king's man, brahmin's; other chiefs, other unities — king's horse, man (vv19-20).
Course told, delusion denied, seal spoken: Māyā-knower-resting intellects drive transaction, moment-grounded in self-awareness; told, proved, unrefuted, useful, full apparatus besides (vv21-23).
